DeepLIFT' vs 'New DeepLIFT' as two variants -- paper never states a single explicit model count.

n_datasets=1 counts only the named MNIST digit dataset (Section 5.3); Sections 5.1-5.2 use synthetic/simulated decision-tree models and toy scenarios (sickness score, max-allocation game) with no named dataset, so the true count of 'datasets' depends on whether synthetic simulated settings are counted.
No seed or repetition count is stated anywhere; Figure 3 reports '200 replicate estimates' (a sampling-estimate count, not a random-seed count), so n_seeds is left null rather than imputed.

No formal significance test (p-value, CI test) is reported anywhere in the paper; agreement with human explanations is assessed only via majority/most-common response tallies (Figure 4), not a stated statistical test.
